Norman G readings 1–4 are complete. All prescribed scientific calls exited 0; no retry, source/criterion change, model promotion or new paid run.

Primary: 223 original table-mentioning plugins produced 174 eligible rows (44/62/68 over runs 0/2/3), 40 within-source duplicates and 9 disclosed exclusions (6 dependency KeyErrors, 1 constant smoke failure, 2 literal-cap refusals). All 174 were selected unchanged without --k/--partial and tested in one call with 999 replicates. The corrected pool has 158 unique rows after 16 cross-source duplicates, partial=false, untested=[], no resolution warning, found=[] and tier1=[]. No row passes the fixed complete-family criteria. Independent audit reconstructed raw and pooled step-down p-values from stored gains and checked all numerical/other gates, coefficient signs, membership and plugin hashes: PASS. Of 59 proportional rows, 56 have valid perturbation nulls; the other 3 are full-view-only, fail consistency and minimum effect, and are not accepted. Raw helper heading remains Block F/gene_annotation; scope here is Norman G/all three tables.

Reading 2: exact one-call six-run OOF comparison, null-reps 0, 110 successful rows (104 add-one + 6 sets), split_a391fa9e7b4eccb7. Independent numerical/provenance/rounding audit: PASS. These fixed ridge refits choose alpha honestly across OOF seeds but reuse development labels; selected models were exposed to val1+oof. Source limitations: g1 r0 e201's normalized constraint weight cancels for one usable target (oe_lof_upper/case-sensitive pLI, missing weight 1). G1 r2 e89 falls back from bidirectional to an adjacent-index/control-expression proxy; e515 falls back from neighbours to correlation degree; e585 uses control variance and sequence fields, not a cell-type atlas. Other direct fields include cpg_oe_promoter, oe_lof_upper and protein_length. G1 r3 e519 compares loci[1] TSS windows without checking chromosome equality and stores strand unused; other branches use LOEUF/pLI, protein_length and nucleus. Dynamic network calls and parameter-chosen dependencies mean these static direct counts are not exhaustive runtime attribution. Exact source hashes, schema-name literals, key expressions and fallback/proxy caveats are preserved.
